mapper.select: SELECT p.*, u.avatar AS creator_avatar,u.name AS creator_name, r.type AS post_rating_type, b.name AS board_name, b.cover AS board_cover FROM posts p LEFT JOIN users u ON p.creator = u.id LEFT JOIN ratings r ON p.id = r.target_id AND r.target = 'POST' AND r.creator = #{userId} LEFT JOIN boards b ON p.board_id = b.id
